preamble: Periodic Piece Clues are listed in alphabetical order of their solutions and all are normal. Each solution contains the symbol letter(s) for an element, either one letter (which except for K, V and Y is always the first letter of the solution), or two letters (which occur anywhere, not always together but always in the right order). Each solution is to be entered in the diagram at the atomic number of its element. The required information can be found in encyclopedias (usually under ATOM) and in dictionaries, but some editions of Chambers omit the atomic no. of chlorine [17] and wrongly give 51 instead of 48 for cadmium.

clue.text: Dutch spy connected with Jan

explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a word-game definition: put this word in front of JAN and you get HARIJAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Mata Hari is the famous stage name of the spy, and Harijan is an Indian word built from this element plus jan.

clue.text: Dutchman holding record as assistant
